title: Shiseido returns to profit in Q3 26, but Drunk Elephant records ‘severe underperformance’
summary: Despite returning to profit, Drunk Elephant global sales decreased 23% during the quarter after recording ‘some severe underperformance’ in US e-commerce sales

extraction.key_fact: 시세이도는 흑자로 돌아섰지만 Drunk Elephant의 글로벌 매출은 줄었다.
